questions.question: Clarify the positions in Reichenau and Jena and the distinction between a chair of philosophy and an academic degree; verify the account of graduation from Göttingen.

localizations.source: Clarify the positions in Reichenau and Jena and the distinction between a chair of philosophy and an academic degree; verify the account of graduation from Göttingen.
localizations.ru: Уточнить характер должностей в Райхенау и Йене и различие между кафедрой философии и учёной степенью; сверить сведения об окончании Гёттингенского университета.

questions.resolution: The account now follows MacTutor and Deutsche Biographie: study at Göttingen, a doctorate at Jena in 1799, and teaching posts in Reichenau, Aarau and Jena. https://mathshistory.st-andrews.ac.uk/Biographies/Bartels/ ; https://www.deutsche-biographie.de/gnd116062665.html

questions.question: Clarify the wording of Rumovsky’s trusteeship and the precise chronology of Bartels’s invitation; compare with the journal’s published biography of Rumovsky.

localizations.source: Clarify the wording of Rumovsky’s trusteeship and the precise chronology of Bartels’s invitation; compare with the journal’s published biography of Rumovsky.
localizations.ru: Уточнить формулировку о попечительстве Румовского и точную хронологию приглашения Бартельса; сопоставить с опубликованной биографией Румовского в журнале.

questions.resolution: The founding of Kazan University, Rumovsky’s invitation in 1807 and Bartels’s arrival in 1808 now follow the MacTutor biography. https://mathshistory.st-andrews.ac.uk/Biographies/Bartels/

questions.question: Confirm the original source of the portrait and the basis for reproduction.

localizations.ru: Подтвердить первоисточник портрета и основание его воспроизведения.

questions.resolution: This was a general request to recheck the archival portrait. The source attribution is retained and the note identifies no specific discrepancy.
